run_concate_gt_render: run the script to convert ground truth and rendered images from a folder into a side-by-side MP4 video
run_concate_to_video: run concate_to_video to stitch ground truth and rendered image sequences into a single MP4 clip
run_render_set: run render_set to render a dataset of views using a Gaussian model and save outputs as images
run_get_render_path_rotate: run get_render_path_rotate to generate camera poses that orbit around a point cloud with configurable lifting angle
run_visualize_pcd_with_cameras: run visualize_pcd_with_cameras to display a point cloud with colored camera frustums in an Open3D viewer
